When anything waits on Kam: post a fleet-activity card in the same action, never chat only. Morning card counts what awaits him. Never idle on him; flag blockers, never push past; 48h unanswered = email. Datasec order: HPSM-POC, Calculator, Composer.

When backing up or offloading: use this seat's nas_offload.sh into DEV-Working/<own client>/<Seat>/<date>_<topic>/ (verified, MANIFEST, review +30d). Copy never move, no secrets, never touch the other client's folder; delete past review only on Kam's word.

Wednesday's home machine is the always-on Mac mini since 2026-11-11 (the laptop travels). On any machine: check the host alias, binary path and volume a tool names before trusting it; rc 1 from a copy tool means wrong binary first; in zsh use /usr/bin/log.

Secuura audit records and verification: anyone may READ, but no public answer carries anything derived from a person (user id, email, IP, free text); WRITE is the creator plus contract-allowed uses. Exports and documents keep own rulings.

When a build seat records tool output as fixtures: generate from a scratch tree, never the real drive. Before a repo goes public or leaves its project, sweep every branch and all history (positive controls); fixing history is Kam's call.
